name: Link Fetch

access.files: reads zip files the user names in Downloads, Desktop or Documents (to merge Google Drive's split downloads), and reads the project folder the user names to check a fetch was copied there before clear_fetch removes the add-on's own temporary copy

notes: Downloads client deliveries from Dropbox, WeTransfer and Google Drive share links, unzips them and organises the files (sessions, stems, references) into a song's folder. Needs the internet for those three services only.
